guardrails: Candidate status alone does not raise a person to major-national score 3.
Exact 2021 evidence overrides a higher 2022 role when the protocol requires 2021-first priority.
Death is a competing event, not failure.
Unresolved same-person continuity remains untraceable rather than a forced zero.
